card.name: Liver test thresholds before a number
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word (to, than) right before a numeric multiple of ULN or a bilirubin cutoff. It appears in liver enzyme and bilirubin stopping rules.

modes.label: Space before the number
modes.description: The gap right after 'more than' or 'up to' and before a number such as 3 times ULN.
modes.example: Total bilirubin increases to more than<< >>3 times ULN Permanently dis

modes.label: Linking word in the threshold
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'than' in 'equal to' or 'more than' before a liver threshold value.
modes.example: bilirubin greater than or equal<< to>> 10 x ULN is unknown

card.plain: It lights up just before the number in liver test cutoffs, such as bilirubin above 3 times the upper limit of normal.
